author: The Current
description:
Watch performances and interviews with Singing Resistance
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Singing Resistance, a group who formed during the ICE occupation of the Twin Cities, brought their songs of community, solidarity and joy into The Current studio for a session hosted by Zach McCormick.

Watch the full session above.
